title: Onboard OrionX-11B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and automate changelog
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: Motivation: Add OrionX-11B v1.0 to the model registry with validated performance profiles, standardized model metadata, and automated changelog entry generation. This PR includes: 1) onboarding metadata (model card, tokenizer, quantization recommendations); 2) performance profiles (latency/throughput baselines across common sequence lengths and batch sizes, memory footprints for single-GPU and multi-GPU serving); 3) integration with the changelog automation pipeline so releases and registry updates automatically generate release notes and CHANGELOG entries; 4) small compatibility shim for runtime kernel selection to prefer the newer attention kernel for OrionX. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata YAML and model card - [x] Add perf profile JSON with test vectors - [x] Add changelog automation template and CI check - [x] Add unit tests for registry ingestion - [x] Validate end-to-end onboarding on perf-canary infra - [x] Update docs snippet and example invocation. Context: OrionX is a community model with quality/latency characteristics that fit our mid-size low-latency tier (target customers: product teams needing fast completions under 100ms for short prompts). Related: Linear ENG-4212 (onboard pipeline), ENG-4250 (perf-profile schema), PM-318 (model catalog updates). Implementation notes: Metadata added under models/orionx/11b/v1.0/{metadata.yaml,model_card.md}. Perf profiles added under perf-profiles/orionx-11b-v1.0.json including results from our perf-canary runs (seq=32/128/512, batch=1/8/16). Changelog automation: added a registry webhook rule and a changelog template that the automation job consumes to populate release notes when a model version is tagged. CI: a new changelog-check step verifies template rendering against the model metadata. See files_changed for details. Merge notes: squash-merged after final approval and a successful canary run.
commits: Add initial metadata and model card for orionx-11b v1.0
Add perf profile JSON and test vectors from perf-canary runs
Add changelog automation template and CI job (changelog-check)
Add unit tests for registry ingestion and schema validation
Fix attention-kernel shim to prefer orionx optimized kernels

release_notes: Onboard OrionX-11B v1.0: added model metadata and card, perf profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, and automated changelog generation for registry updates. Recommended quantization: fp16/4-bit hybrid. See perf summary for latency/throughput baselines.
